# Aether

> Aether is a digital services studio helping students and early-career professionals launch their careers online — through portfolio websites, ATS-optimized CVs, presentation design, and LinkedIn optimization. Based in Pakistan, serving clients remotely.

Aether was built by a mechanical engineering student who understands the gap between having skills and being able to present them. Every service is designed to turn raw talent into something that gets noticed by recruiters, clients, and employers.

## Services

- [Portfolio & Websites](https://aethers.studio/services/portfolio-websites): Custom personal portfolio and small business websites, PKR 5,999–17,999, built to showcase real work and convert visitors into opportunities.
- [CV & Career Docs](https://aethers.studio/services/cv-career-docs): ATS-optimized CVs and career documents, PKR 1,999–7,999, written to pass automated screening and stand out to human recruiters.
- [Presentations & Slide Decks](https://aethers.studio/services/presentations): Professional presentation design, PKR 999–3,999, for academic, business, and pitch use cases.
- [LinkedIn Optimization](https://aethers.studio/services/linkedin-optimization): Full LinkedIn profile optimization, PKR 1,499, covering headline, summary, and keyword positioning for recruiter visibility.
